definitions.explanation: A structured display of information organized in rows and columns, or a list or schedule. Common in academic, business, and everyday contexts.

examples.japanese: {時刻表|じこくひょう}を{確認|かくにん}する。
データを{表|ひょう}にまとめてください。
examples.english: Please organize the data into a table.

examples.japanese: {報告書|ほうこくしょ}の{最後|さいご}に{参考|さんこう}{資料|しりょう}の{一覧表|いちらんひょう}を{付|つ}けた。
examples.english: I attached a reference list at the end of the report.

notes:
Refers to organized displays of information — tables, charts, lists, and schedules. Extremely productive as a suffix in compound words. Note that this is a different word from {表|おもて} (surface, front side).

COMPOUNDS:
- {時刻表|じこくひょう} — timetable
- {一覧表|いちらんひょう} — list, catalog
- {成績表|せいせきひょう} — report card, grade sheet
- {料金表|りょうきんひょう} — price list
- {年表|ねんぴょう} — chronological table, timeline
- {図表|ずひょう} — charts and tables
- {対照表|たいしょうひょう} — comparison table
- {換算表|かんさんひょう} — conversion table

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {表|ひょう}にまとめる — to organize into a table
- {表|ひょう}を{作|つく}る — to make a table/chart
- {表|ひょう}を{見|み}る — to look at a table

DIFFERENT READINGS OF {表|ひょう}:
- {表|おもて} — surface, front side, outside (different word)
- {表|ひょう} — table, chart (this entry)
- Both readings are very common but have completely different meanings.
